'''Roogak''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Galactic Horizon]]''. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the ''Galactic Horizon'' hosted a peace conference, and Roogak's business associate [[Dayla Kev]] persuaded him to allow her to release several dangerous creatures aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] during the event, as part of an attempt to seek revenge against [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Milac Troper]].<ref name="GC6" />
